items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1962-01-04
items.q: I believe Danny Barker played about his first job with me... I had a three piece job... We was working on a thing every night.

ctx.x: Did you ever play with Danny Barker back then? Yeah. Yeah.

I believe, if I'm not mistaken, I believe Danny Barker played about his first job with me. Uh huh. Out in high, I had a three piece job out at the lake on Lake Front there. We was working on a thing every night. And I got Danny Barker in a drum. We got that for, oh, I guess about a year or a better.
Was that every night of the week or just weekends? That was every night. Every night? Yeah.
